name: packetplay
description: Describe a system in YAML or JSON, get one self-contained animated HTML page.

scripts.build:example: bun run src/cli.ts build examples/webrtc.scene.yaml -o dist/webrtc.html
scripts.build:examples: bun run src/cli.ts build examples/webrtc.scene.yaml -o dist/webrtc.html && bun run src/cli.ts build examples/udp.scene.yaml -o dist/udp.html && bun run src/cli.ts build examples/website.scene.yaml -o dist/website.html && bun run src/cli.ts build examples/osi.scene.yaml -o dist/osi.html && bun run src/cli.ts build examples/homenet.scene.yaml -o dist/homenet.html
